title: Zebulun's Inheritance
description: The third lot fell to the descendants of Zebulun. The boundary ran from Sarid westward toward Maralah and Jokneam, and eastward through Kishloth-Tabor, Daberath and Japhia, continuing to Gath-hepher, Rimmon and Hannathon, ending in the valley of Jiftah-el. Altogether, the tribe received twelve cities with their surrounding villages as an inheritance.
